blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب استحباب صلاة الضحي
blocks.tamil_translation: "(In gratitude) for every joint in your body functioning properly, it is an obligation on each one of you to give a charity every morning. Every time you say "Subhan-Allah" is a charity; every time you say Alhamdulillah is a charity; every time you say La ilaha illallah is a charity; every time you say Allahu Akbar is a charity; enjoining good is a charity, and forbidding evil is a charity; and praying two rak'ahs at the time of Duha, as a way of giving thanks for every joint functioning properly, will suffice" — Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ بُرَيْدَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: فِي اْلإِنْسَانِ ثَلثُمِائَةٍ وَسِتُّونَ مَفْصِلاً، فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ عَنْ كُلِّ مَفْصِلٍ مِنْهُ بِصَدَقَةٍ قَالُوا: وَمَنْ يُطِيقُ ذلِكَ يَانَبِيَّ اللهِ؟ قَالَ: النُّخَاعَةُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ تَدْفِنُهَا، وَالشَّيْءُ تُنَحِّيهِ عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدْ فَرَكْعَتَا الضُّحَي تُجْزِئُكَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في اماطة الاذي عن الطريق رقم:٥٢٤٢
blocks.tamil_translation: When Rasulullah ﷺ said, "In the body of a human being there are three hundred and sixty joints, and it is an obligation on him to give one charity as thanks for each joint being healthy," the Sahabah asked, "O Rasulullah, who is able to give so much charity?' "If you see spittle in the masjid, burying it in the earth is a charity. Removing harmful things from the path is a charity.
